term: one-way temporal presence to world-relative actual existence
definition: HistoryPresenceActual h means every IsAt v c t implies h.ontic.ExistsAt v c, for every time. It is the one-way EVER-history interpretation required to retain an earlier cause as actual in that history; no converse, now-slice coherence or temporal persistence is asserted.
note: History itself does not imply this bridge. CoherentAtNow has a different meaning and does not supply presence at an arbitrary earlier time. World-history interpretation and applicability remain explicit open commitments; the original Ontic and History fields are unchanged.
